parallel.requirements: The parallel run recognized the need for pure Node.js ESM .mjs files, manual argparse-like handling for required --a --b --c --d, local imports only, and black-box furl fragment emulation.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The root delegated CLI behavior and fragment behavior to child agents while also implementing the final entrypoint and module tree itself; a nested CLI probe was spawned by the CLI child.
parallel.implementation: The fragment child produced one implementation under /output/cli and /output/lib, while the root later produced a different implementation under /output/lib/cli, /output/lib/fragment, and /output/lib/url.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The submitted parallel artifact contains root-owned modules and leftover child-owned modules plus one test12.mjs entrypoint, showing mixed provenance around the deliverable namespace.
parallel.verification: The root and fragment child both ran representative executable comparisons for help, error, encoding, and fragment cases, but the official evaluator still failed hidden cases at 101/160.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The direct CLI child was interrupted while still active, the child implementation result arrived after the root patch, and hidden evaluator cases remained unsatisfied.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same pure Node.js ESM .mjs, manual argv parsing, no external dependencies, and /output delivery requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single root agent owned probing, implementation, verification, and final delivery without delegation or cross-agent handoff.
serial.implementation: The serial run wrote a compact coherent module set with argparse, encoding, fragment, furl, and test12.mjs files.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial artifact lists only that one coherent module tree and the expected test12.mjs entrypoint.
serial.verification: The serial run compared the Node output against the executable across representative normal, parser, encoding, and fragment-join cases before finalizing.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite a cleaner lifecycle, the serial implementation also failed official hidden cases with the same 101/160 score.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one actor for probing, coding, verifying, and final response with no delegation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child reports were visible, including nested CLI behavior and a fragment implementation report, but competing implementation paths were not reconciled into a single explicit interface contract.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no cross-agent interface handoff and maintained one local module interface set.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The material difference is not a missing brief but the presence of cross-agent result and workspace coordination boundaries in parallel.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote a root implementation after independent child implementation work, creating different module hierarchies for the same task.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote one implementation with argparse, encoding, fragment, furl, and entrypoint modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had competing implementation paths in the shared output tree; serial had one internally consistent path.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel interrupted the direct CLI child while it was still running and then later received the fragment child's completed implementation report after root patching.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle and closed after completing implementation and verification locally.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel exposed active child termination and late child-result timing; serial had no equivalent result lifecycle risk.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel final artifact contains one test12.mjs plus both child-style helper files and root-style helper files, showing mixed output provenance.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial final artifact contains one coherent helper set and one test12.mjs entrypoint.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel left competing implementation artifacts in the submitted tree; serial did not.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran representative local checks after writing the root implementation and claimed coverage of normal, parser, and encoding cases.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also ran representative executable comparisons covering normal, help/error, encoding, and fragment joins.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both verified representative behavior but neither matched enough hidden official cases; verification breadth did not create an outcome difference.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used substantial fan-out and four subagents across a 600 second agent run, but completed and returned a final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no subagents and completed in a shorter single-threaded run with a final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel consumed more orchestration budget and carried extra lifecycle/write issues, but both runs closed and failed identically.

outcome_analysis.explanation: There is no discordant official outcome in the current completed status records. Parallel and serial both failed the official evaluator with 101 passed samples out of 160 and solution_passed false. The task-solving difference is process-level: parallel created child lifecycle and shared-output conflicts, while serial produced one coherent implementation tree. Those adverse parallel events cannot be claimed to explain an outcome gap because no outcome gap exists.
parallel_contributors: Parallel used subagents and retained adverse coordination events: an active CLI child was interrupted and competing implementations touched the required entrypoint namespace.
serial_contributors: Serial avoided child lifecycle and shared-output coordination issues by keeping probing, implementation, verification, and finalization in one actor.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both solutions likely missed hidden furl emulation edge cases despite representative black-box probing, as shown by equal 101/160 official scores.
The serial and parallel root implementations used different helper layouts and parsing details, but the official scores do not isolate a unique coding defect.
evaluator_effects: The completed cell/status.json evaluation supersedes any stale aggregate field and resolves both modes to the same failed outcome.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained patterns are adverse parallel process events only
